patch.description: Maintainer-admitted current-main integration of the accepted solid, opaque inspection-toolbar grouping only. Packet: docs/planning/UIQ-08-INTEGRATION-ADMISSION.md; live gates: docs/planning/UIQ-08-INTEGRATION-GOAL.md.
patch.expectation: The existing inspection controls gain a clearer, accessible native grouping without changing any control behavior or the exact flag-off presentation.
acceptanceCriteria: Reuse the accepted candidate adapter and scoped stylesheet without changing candidate source/proof; force its opaque treatment and do not ship glass/translucency.
Embedded uiq_inspection_toolbar defaults on for the accepted release; local override is deterministic; off/unknown/stale preserves exact legacy markup and appearance.
Preserve heading, names, IDs, control order, pointer/keyboard actions, zoom 50%-250%, Fit, focus, scroll, viewport, artwork identity and paused/error inspection output.

Changed production and settled global statements/branches/functions/lines coverage are 100%; type/build, operational, packaged, export identity and rendered responsive/accessibility/no-egress gates pass without baseline changes.
Codex reviews actual diff and evidence; close only after successful main deployment, fresh stable/immutable live verification and validated board closeout.
